prerequisites: Solid knowledge in fundamental engineering mathematics, especially linear algebra, differential and integral calculus.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can name advanced mathematical methods and identify their areas of application in engineering problems.

Students have in-depth knowledge of the mathematical methods that form the basis of common simulation software. They can explain the characteristic properties of the methods and distinguish them from each other.

Students recognize the benefit of mathematical methods and tools in modeling engineering problems. They know the prerequisites of the procedures and can critically assess their advantages and disadvantages.

assessment_rules: The graded examination is a written exam. The duration and scope of the exam are specified in the respective valid study regulations.
